instruction.text: What are the animals doing? Make rhyming couplets.

atoms.sound: The biggest whale can’t see its tail.
The tired bat wears its hat.
The desert snake has not seen a lake.

instruction.text: What are the animals doing? Make rhyming couplets.

atoms.sound: The galloping horse finds a water source.
The large hairy hog is best friends with a frog.
The slow-moving snail leaves a slimy trail.
